status: frozen before any coverage image evaluation; diagnostic only
orientation: core hysteresis 3x3 histogram; unsigned modulo180 labels; exact or adjacent modulo8
bit_decode: 0 -> 255; single bit (1<<k) -> k; multibit rejects pipeline input
scene_preparation: exact baseline grayscale padded input; empty mask; core ColorGradientPyramid weak20; no spread/no pyrDown
padding: left/top64; right/bottom64 plus baseline 16 alignment remainder; zero border
evidence_domain: padded scene; separately report original-frame point fraction; padding transition is artificial evidence
training_reconstruction: frozen adapter recipe; official mask bbox crop, unmasked grayscale RGB crop; same rotate center/canvas; linear RGB/nearest mask; zero border
training_validation: reextract same warped image/mask; require every serialized core pyramid field and feature x/y/label to agree; theta is not serialized; a mismatch aborts
sample_inclusion: official warped mask nonzero, valid histogram orientation, squared Sobel magnitude strictly > 1600
sampling: one strongest pixel per fixed2x2 canvas-origin cell; ties lowest y then x; no feature-count minimum/cap
point_coordinates: canvas pixel minus actual saved L0 tl exactly once; query adds unchanged padded core match_x/match_y
cell_grid: 4x4 over complete inclusive integer extent; col=floor(4*(x-minx)/(maxx-minx+1)), analogous row; occupied cells equally weighted
unverified: empty/untrusted set passes unchanged with explicit reason; blank scene is verified
cache: complete every post85 candidate before any coverage NMS; each threshold runs independent lazy path; compare retained original fields/order and all kept coverage fields
raw_reuse: require frozen actual85 provenance, full fallback/fused equivalence, bank/config/core/source/dataset/image/archive SHA and complete manifest/rank/count consistency
evaluation: reuse frozen public adapter bbox/canonicalLess/nms/evaluate helpers; report baseline and every policy, allGT and eligible counts, negative FP, per-scene; no new threshold selection
timing: diagnostic phase timings only; no paired speed claim; include second gradient pass, maps, point queries, full/lazy/NMS
promotion: no production default change; requires positive retention and development quality assessment plus independent review; heldout remains sealed
